AboutSection.subtitle: About Vyanzo
AboutSection.description: Born in 2018, Vyanzo manufactures manhole covers, grates, and municipal castings: supplied across Europe and beyond. Quality, service, and reliability aren't just promises. They're the standard.

EnvironmentSection.subtitle: Environmental Responsibility
EnvironmentSection.description: Zero coal. Electrical induction furnaces. Rooftop solar. Every facility is built to minimize footprint: not just meet standards, but set them.

ContactSection.subtitle: Your Next Step

hero.subtitle: Company Profile
hero.description: Discover our range of meticulously designed and manufactured products. Vyanzo delivers top-quality castings to the most demanding customers — consistent quality and service level are paramount to what we do.

philosophy.title: Quality, Service & Reliability with relentless consistency.
philosophy.description: Since its inception in 2018, Vyanzo has evolved from an OEM supplier to become a leading manufacturer of its own range of Manhole Covers, Grates and other municipal casting products now supplied across Europe.

service.title: End-to-End Service
service.description: We offer end-to-end services to customers around the world who share our business philosophy: Quality, Service & Reliability at a correct price — and that with relentless consistency. By managing production, quality assurance, and logistics in-house, Vyanzo ensures a seamless experience for its clients.
